report_title: L&I Field Inspection Summary — Q4 2024 / Q1 2025

inspections.findings: Site visit confirmed incomplete siding replacement. Approximately 40% of south and east elevations remain unfinished. Exposed sheathing and house wrap showing weather damage. No workers on site. Homeowner (J. Petrov) reports no contact from contractor since August 2023. Contractor's listed phone number is disconnected.

Observed two workers installing electrical panel upgrade. Company van marked 'NextGen Solar Installations — Lic Pending'. Workers identified supervisor as Aiden Torres. Checked L&I database — no active license found for this entity. Work included 200-amp panel swap and new circuit runs, which constitutes electrical contracting requiring licensure. Issued stop-work advisory on site. Homeowner (C. Wright) stated contractor quoted $15,000 for solar-ready panel upgrade.

On-site verification for license reinstatement consideration. Observed active electrical installation project at commercial tenant improvement. Crew of 4 on site. All workers wearing proper PPE. Journeyman electrician cards verified for 3 of 4 workers. David Park (principal) present and cooperative. Current bond and insurance documentation reviewed on-site — both appear valid. Prior violations (VIO-2022-0341, VIO-2022-0892) confirmed paid in full per L&I records. Recommend clearance of violation hold for reinstatement purposes, subject to standard background check review.
inspections.conditions_noted: Background check flagged prior misdemeanor — requires supervisor review before final clearance. One crew member (4th worker) could not produce journeyman card; contractor stated card was being renewed. Verify within 30 days.

inspections.findings: Pre-licensing interview with Robert T. Nguyen, principal of Cascade Plumbing Solutions (App #2025004). Applicant confirmed 5 years plumbing experience working under licensed master plumber in Oregon. Holds Oregon plumber journeyman license (OR-PLB-2019-44821). Discussed failed WA exam (score 58). Applicant expressed confidence in retaking exam and requested provisional approval. Informed applicant that WA statute does not allow provisional licensure for specialty trades. Applicant's Oregon credentials do not transfer — WA requires separate examination. Applicant cooperative and professional throughout interview.
